100781.title: Wheel build overview
guidance: Inspect 1 EA HL Spindle/Axle (Product Number SD-9872) and 1 EA HL Shell (Product Number SH-9312). Conceptually fit them as the 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998); actual internal assembly requires verified component instructions.
Inspect 1 EA HL Road Rim (Product Number RM-R800), 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) and 36 EA HL Nipple (Product Number NI-9522) for visible damage and count them.
Using an assumed wheel-building stand, demonstrate connecting the spokes between the hub and rim with the nipples. The lacing pattern and tension require verification; see illustration 100781.

100782.title: Tire, tube and reflector overview
guidance: Inspect 1 EA HL Road Rim (Product Number RM-R800), 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) and 36 EA HL Nipple (Product Number NI-9522) for visible damage and count them.

Inspect 1 EA Road Tire Tube (Product Number TT-R982) and 1 EA HL Road Tire (Product Number TI-R982), then demonstrate fitting the tube inside the tire and the tire onto the rim. Verify fit and inflation instructions; see illustration 100782.
